decisions.reason: The updated flat plan changes editorial ordering but does not alter the requirement to show each article's author name and photo.
The updated flat plan does not change the obligation to request supplemental images when needed to balance article layouts.
Editorial ordering may affect the PDF's eventual contents, but it does not change the requirement to deliver a flipbook-ready digital PDF.
The updated flat plan does not modify the requirement to enhance magazine image quality when needed.
Providing a newer flat plan does not explicitly or necessarily change the July 25 digital launch deadline.
